start.text: Hesper is at the staithe's foot as always, but she isn't looking at the boat. She's looking north, over the reed roofs of Stillhithe, at the Deeps.
The eel-man came by at first light. He says the light's gone off the end of the long walk.
Not out. Off. It's halfway in, and it's stopped. It's been stopped since yesterday.
I can't go and look. I've his name in my keeping; it isn't mine to carry out to him. That's the one way it's done.
I've no name of my own to go out under, and I've his in my keeping. It isn't mine to carry out to him. That's the one way it's done.
You've a light, though. Boards only go the one way out there.
